Short title, extent and commencement

ACT III OF 2017
ACT III OF 2017
BALOCHISTAN SENIOR CITIZENS ACT, 2017
An Act to provide for the well-being, comfort and
other benefits
to the Senior Citizens in Balochistan and to make
provisions
for the welfare of the Senior Citizens
[Gazette of Balochistan
Extraordinary,
8th June, 2017]
No.
PAB/Legis:v(04)/2017/8833, dated 8.6.2017.---The Balochistan Senior Citizens Bill (Bill No. 04 of 2017) having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 20th May, 2017 and assented
to by the Governor, Balochistan on 07th June, 2017 is hereby published as an
Act of the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---WHAREAS the Constitution of the Islamic Republic
of Pakistan, 1973, enjoin on the state to alleviate the sufferings of all the
citizens, irrespective of sex, caste, creed or race. Therefore, it is expedient
to make provision for the well-being, comfort and social security to the Senior
Citizens living in the Province of Balochistan;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title, extent and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Balochistan Senior Citizens Act, 2017.
(2) It
shall extend to the whole of Province of Balochistan, except Tribal Areas.
(3) It
shall come into force at once.

Definitions

It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Definitions.---In this Act, unless there is anything repugnant
in the subject or context:-
(a) "Act"
means the Balochistan Senior Citizens Act, 2017;
(b) "Chairperson"
means the Chairperson of the Council;
(c) "Council"
means the Balochistan Senior Citizens Welfare Councils established under section 3 of this Act;
(d) "Senior
Citizens" means a citizen of Pakistan of the age of 60 years or above
and a permanent resident of Balochistan;
(e) "Retired"
means a person retired from Government Service or any other such job in Public
or Private Sector, on attaining the retirement age whatsoever it may be;
(f) "Government"
means the Government of Balochistan;
(g) "Allowance"
means a Senior Citizens Social Security Allowance;
(h) "Welfare"
includes all such services relating to social, economic, boarding, lodging and
legal protection of Senior Citizens;
(i) "Welfare
packages/grants" welfare and social security packages/grants announced
for welfare of the Senior Citizens by the Provincial Government on the
recommendations of the Senior Citizens Council;
(j) "Prescribed"
means prescribed under the rules; and
(k) "Rules"
means the rules made under section 11 of this Act.

Establishment of the Senior Citizens Welfare Council

Preamble.---WHAREAS the Constitution of the Islamic Republic

3. Establishment
of the Senior Citizens Welfare Council.---(1) The Government shall establish a Council for the purposes of this
Act, to be known as Balochistan Senior Citizens Welfare Council, which shall be
constituted by the Provincial Government and shall exercise the powers
conferred upon, and to perform the functions assigned to it, under this Act;
(2) The
Council shall be an independent, non-profit body corporate by the above said
name, having perpetual succession and a common seal, with power, subject to the
provisions of this Act, to enter contracts, acquire, purchase, hold and dispose
of both movable and immovable property and shall by its name, sue or be sued;
(3) The
Council shall be provided with necessary trained human resource which shall be
responsible for providing secretariat support to the Council and to perform
such other functions as may be assigned to them.

Composition of the Council

4. Composition
of the Council.---(1) The
Government shall constitute the council which shall consist of___,
(a) Chairperson:
An eminent Senior Citizen of good standing who has rendered services for the
cause of senior citizen to be nominated by the Chief Minister/Government for a
period of 3 years extendable for a period of three years;
(b) Vice
Chairperson: Approved by the Council; and
(c) Members:-
i. Secretary,
Social Welfare, Government of Balochistan.
ii. A
representative from Finance Department. (Not below the rank of Deputy
Secretary)
iii. A
representative from Planning and Development Department. (Not below the rank of
Deputy Secretary)
iv. A
representative from Health Department. (Not below the rank of Deputy Secretary)
v. A
representative from Home Department. (Not below the rank of Deputy Secretary)
vi. A
representative from Law Department. (Not below the rank of Deputy Secretary)
vii. All
Divisional Commissioners in Balochistan. (Officer not below the rank of Deputy
Secretary)
viii. Director
General, Social Welfare Department.
ix. Director,
Bait-ul-Mal.
x. Chief
Executive, Trust for Voluntary Organizations (TVO).
xi. President
of the Association for the Welfare of Retired Persons.
xii. President
Senior Citizen Association Balochistan Member/Secretary.
xiii. Four
representatives of NGOs (two from Seniors Organizations and two from other NGOs
preferably working for senior citizens) nominated by the Chairperson.
(2) The
office of the Council shall be at Quetta.
(3) The
Council has power to co-opt members from among persons who are experts in their
respective fields, for advice on particular projects and matters under
consideration.
(4) The
members of the Council, except the ex-officio members, shall be nominated
office for a term of three years and extendable for another term of three years
if approved by the Council.
(5) A
member of the Council, other than an ex-officio member, may tender his resignation
to Chairperson.
(6)
The membership of ex-officio member may cease to exist in case he___,
a) is
guilty of misconduct;
b) is
adjudged an insolvent;
c) is
unfit to continue in office by reason of infirmity of mind or body;
d) is
convicted and sentenced to imprisonment for an offence which involves moral
turpitude; or
e) lack
of interest or absence for three or more consecutive meetings of the council.
(7) Any
casual vacancy in the office of a member, other than an ex-officio member,
shall be filled by a person nominated by the Government and the person so
nominated shall hold office for the remaining period of the term of his
predecessor.

5. Procedure
and meeting of the Council.---(1)
The Council shall regulate its own procedure which will be approved in a
meeting of the Council.
(2) The
meetings of the Council shall be held at least four times a year, and shall be
presided over by the Chairperson or, in absence, by the Vice chairperson and in
the absence of both of them by a member nominated by Chairperson for purpose or
a member chosen for the purpose by the present members.
(3) One
third of the total members shall constitute the quorum and no quorum shall be
necessary for the adjourned meeting.
(4) All
decisions of the Council shall be taken with simple majority of the Council;
the Chairperson shall have a casting vote in case of tie.
(5) Decision
of the Council shall be recorded by the Secretary/ member of the Council, who
shall circulate such decisions for confirmation to each member and the
Chairperson within fifteen days of each meeting.
(6) Secretary/Member
shall be responsible for implementation of the decisions of the Council under
the direction, supervision and control of the Chairperson.

shall be the head of the secretariat of the Senior Citizen Welfare Council,
Balochistan, and perform his functions under the direct control and supervision
of the Chairperson.

Powers and Functions of the Council

7. Powers
and Functions of the Council.---Powers
and Function of the Council shall be;
(a) to
formulate policy proposal on aging in the light of Provincial commitment on the
welfare of older persons and submit it to the Government for approval from time
to time;
(b) to
conduct research and compile data on various aspect of aging for the well being
of Senior citizens for policy/plan formulation;
(c) to
work towards introduction of geriatrics as part of the syllabus of medical universities
/ colleges and institutions;
(d) to
propose arrangements in hospitals for better medical attention to Senior
citizens;
(e) to
create facilities including clubs, for better social inter-action among Senior
citizens;
(f) to
arrange workshops to educate Senior Citizens about life changes required for a
healthy and stratifying old age;
(g) to
formulate proposals to accommodate the requirements of Senior Citizens in urban
and rural planning and development schemes;
(h) mobilization
of financial resources for welfare of the Senior Citizens;
(i) to
approve appointments of all employees of the Council Secretariat and other
institutions established for welfare and protection of Senior Citizens under
the Council Act;
(j) to
constitute committees, assessment boards and study group to assess and carry
out welfare activities for Senior Citizens;
(k) to
coordinate with government, non-government and international social and welfare
organizations at national level;
(l) to
make regulations/rules for proper functioning of the Council including
regulations for appointment of different categories of employees under the
administrative control of the Council;
(m) to
publish reports and other material for guidance and welfare of Senior Citizens;
(n) to
grant awards to the Senior Citizens in the fields of their expertise; and
(o) to
create awareness in the public through organizing seminars, workshops,
conferences and use of mass media.

8. Privileges
to Senior Citizens.---(1) The
Senior Citizens will be allowed the following privileges on the basis of senior
citizen card:-
(a) Senior
Citizens will be allowed free of charge entry to public museums, libraries,
parks and recreation facilities projected for Senior Citizens in Province and
Federal controlled;
(b) financial
supports will be given to families that have the responsibilities of
looking-after their senior citizens including parents;
The hospital authorities will provide
the following facilities in the hospitals___,
(i) separate
counters for Senior Citizens in Hospital;
(ii) concession
in medical and medicine charges; and
(iii) separate
medical wards; and
(d) in
all the Public Offices, Banks, Railway Stations separate counters for Senior
Citizens will be provided or given priority over others.
(2) The
following measures shall also be taken for the welfare of the Senior Citizen:-
(a) establishment
of Senior Citizen homes to accommodate homeless, deserted and indigent aged persons;
(b) inclusion
of the subject Geriatrics in the curriculum of medical universities/colleges;
(c) voluntary
organizations will be encouraged and assisted to organize services such as day
care, multi service citizens, reach out services, supply of disability related
aids and appliances; and
(d) recognize
the services of prominent Senior Citizens through celebrations whenever
required.

9. Senior
Citizens Welfare fund.---(1) There
shall be a fund established by the
Government to be known as the Senior Citizens Welfare Fund, which shall
consist of___,
(a) all
grants, budgetary allocations made by the Government;
(b) Donations,
non-endowments, contributions made by the
private individual organizations within
country and abroad; and
(c) All
sums received by the Council from any other source including Pakistan
Bait-ul-Mal, Profits Investment from funds, funds generated by different
motivated campaigns and received from any lawful sources.
(2) Funds
of the Council shall be maintained in a scheduled Bank with prior approval of
the Government/Finance Department; and the same may be invested only in
scheduled banks or other National Saving Banks "Blue Chip" Secure
scheme. No investment will be made in stock market shares or used for
speculation in any manner.
(3) The
Fund shall be administered by the Council, which shall make such allocations
for specific activities, as it may deem appropriate in line with the
fulfillment of functions of the Council, as per sections 8 and 9 of this Act.
(4) The
Government shall make annual budgetary allocations for the establishment and
other charges of the Council. The accounting procedure for this fund will be
prepared in consultation with Finance Department and Accountant General
Balochistan.
(5) The
Accounts of the Council shall be maintained in such form and manner as may be
approved by the Council from time to time.

10. Audit.---(1) The Accounts of the Fund shall be Audited by
the Auditor General of Pakistan or such other authority as the Provincial
Government may appoint in this behalf. The Accounts of the Council shall be
maintained in such form and manner as may be prescribed and shall be audited
yearly by an auditor to be appointed by the Provincial Government, being a
person who is a Chartered
Accountant with the
meaning of Chartered Accounts Ordinance, 1961 (X of 1961).
(2) The
Secretary / Member shall after the end of every financial year, submit to the
Council an audited annual statement of accounts of the Council together with
the report of the auditor.
(3) The
Secretary Member shall be personally liable for utilization of funds of the
council according to aim, objects and purposes of the Council.

exempted from all kinds of taxation or levies under any law in force for the
time being. All donations made to the fund shall also be exempted from all
taxes.
